name.local: 株式会社環境エネルギー投資

funds.name: EEI Booster1号投資事業有限責任組合 (EEI Booster1 Investment LP)

strategy.thesis: Japan's only venture capital firm exclusively focused on the environment and energy sectors, investing in startups driving decarbonization, energy transition (renewables, batteries, power electronics, carbon removal), mobility, and circular economy. Positions impact and business growth as compatible.

summary.en: Founded in 2006, EEI is described as the only Japanese VC firm exclusively focused on the environment and energy sectors. It backs decarbonization, energy-transition, mobility, and circular-economy startups, and in 2024 launched a dedicated growth-stage climate fund (EEI Booster1), which is backed by Japan's government decarbonization investor JICN and the Tokyo Decarbonization VC fund-of-funds.
summary.local: 2006年設立。日本で唯一、環境・エネルギー分野に特化したベンチャーキャピタル。脱炭素・エネルギー転換・モビリティ・循環経済のスタートアップに投資し、2024年にはグロースステージ特化のEEI Booster1号ファンドを組成した。

funds.name: ANRI-GREEN No.1 Investment Limited Partnership (ANRI GREEN 1号)

strategy.thesis: Climate-change and environment-focused fund from independent VC ANRI, backing seed-to-early-stage deeptech in photovoltaics/wind, storage batteries, hydrogen/ammonia, CCUS/DAC, artificial photosynthesis and nuclear fusion, often via industry-university collaboration.

summary.en: ANRI GREEN (ANRI-GREEN No.1) is the climate/environment-dedicated fund of leading Japanese independent VC ANRI, established January 2022 with a ~JPY 10 billion target. Its first close raised JPY 4.3 billion from backers including Japan Investment Corporation's INCJ and Kansai Electric's K4Ventures. It invests seed-to-early-stage in solar/wind, storage, hydrogen/ammonia, CCUS/DAC and fusion.
summary.local: 独立系VC ANRIの気候変動・環境問題特化型ファンド。2022年1月設立、総額100億円規模を目標とし、ファーストクローズで産業革新投資機構やK4Venturesなどから43億円を集めた。

aka: ONEカーボンニュートラル1号

funds.name: ONEカーボンニュートラル1号投資事業有限責任組合 (ONE Carbon Neutral 1st Fund)

strategy.thesis: Japan-based decarbonization-specialized VC supporting innovation to be implemented in society by ~2035 toward carbon neutrality by 2050. Targets seven areas: power-network, mobility, heat-utilization, negative-emissions, region-led, DX-enabled, and industry-specific decarbonization, at seed/early stage.

co_investors: 東京大学協創プラットフォーム開発

summary.en: ONE Innovators is an independent Japanese VC dedicated to the carbon-neutrality field. Its ONE Carbon Neutral 1st Fund was established May 2024 with a target of ~JPY 10 billion, backed by JICN, the University of Tokyo's UTokyo IPC, Mitsui Fudosan, Fuyo General Lease and MUFG Trust. It invests seed/early across seven decarbonization themes.
summary.local: 日本発の脱炭素領域特化型VC。2024年5月に「ONEカーボンニュートラル1号」を設立、最終的なファンド総額は100億円規模を予定。脱炭素化支援機構、東京大学協創プラットフォーム、三井不動産などが出資。

name.local: ジャパンエナジーファンド

strategy.thesis: Climate-tech fund investing in US/European startups (battery tech, smart meter analytics, offshore wind, virtual power plants, demand response) that have potential to scale in Japan. Describes itself as the only fund from Japan purely focused on climate tech investing in US/European startups.

summary.en: Founded 2019, Japan Energy Fund (Japan Energy Capital) is a Tokyo-based climate-tech fund investing in US/European energy startups that can scale in Japan, across battery tech, smart-meter analytics, offshore wind, VPP and demand response. Its second 'decarbonized tech fund' (2021) targeted $50M and is backed by BIPROGY, ENECHANGE, Toshiba ESS and Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank.
summary.local: 2019年設立、東京拠点のクライメートテックファンド。日本で展開可能な米欧のエネルギー系スタートアップに投資。第2号「脱炭素テックファンド」（2021年）は5,000万ドルを目標とし、BIPROGY、ENECHANGE、東芝エネルギーシステムズなどが出資。

Aims to be one of Asia's largest climate funds.

summary.en: Established by Mitsubishi Corporation's GP arm Marunouchi Innovation Partners, the Marunouchi Climate Tech Growth Fund reached a USD 400M first close in April 2023, aiming to be one of Asia's largest climate funds. It invests in growth-stage climate-tech (hydrogen, SAF, renewables, storage, CCUS) over a ~12-year life targeting ~20 companies.

strategy.thesis: Corporate VC of power company JERA making strategic investments across energy transformation (decarbonization, hydrogen/ammonia value chains, renewables, fusion, carbon capture), digital energy platforms, and corporate well-being technologies.

summary.en: JERA Ventures is the corporate VC of JERA, Japan's largest power generator, launched July 2023 with USD 300M. It invests (typically Series A/B, ~$5–10M cheques from JERA's balance sheet) in energy-transition tech — green hydrogen, ammonia, nuclear fusion, carbon capture, renewables and digital energy — globally, with portfolio names including Commonwealth Fusion Systems and Kyoto Fusioneering.
summary.local: 日本最大の発電会社JERAのCVC。2023年7月に総額3億ドルで設立。シリーズA/Bを中心に1件あたり500万〜1,000万ドルを投資し、グリーン水素・アンモニア・核融合・CCUSなどエネルギー転換領域を対象とする。

strategy.thesis: Japan's only VC specialized in the materials and chemistry industry; runs a dedicated decarbonization fund (UMI No.3) investing in early/middle-stage deeptech startups where materials and chemical technologies are key solutions for carbon neutrality.

summary.en: UMI, founded October 2015, is Japan's only VC specialized in materials and chemistry. In 2023 it launched UMI No.3 Decarbonization Tokyo Fund (JPY 1.01 billion), an early/middle-stage deeptech fund for carbon-neutral materials and chemical technologies, backed by the Tokyo Decarbonization VC fund-of-funds and JICN.
summary.local: 2015年10月設立、日本で唯一の素材・化学産業特化型VC。2023年に脱炭素特化の「UMI3号脱炭素東京ファンド」（約10.1億円）を組成し、東京都の脱炭素化VC FOFや脱炭素化支援機構が出資。

name.en: Japan Investment Corporation for Carbon Neutrality (JICN)
name.local: 株式会社脱炭素化支援機構

aum.raw: 資本金 651.5億円 (capital ~JPY 65.15 billion, as of recent)

strategy.thesis: Public-private investment corporation established under the revised Global Warming Countermeasures Act to supply risk capital (equity, mezzanine) to a broad range of decarbonization businesses — renewable energy, storage, hydrogen, circular economy, sustainable agriculture — toward Japan's 2050 carbon-neutral goal.

summary.en: JICN (Japan Investment Corporation for Carbon Neutrality) is a government-private investment body established October 28, 2022 under the revised Global Warming Countermeasures Act, with initial capital of JPY 20.4 billion (half government industrial investment, half from 82 private firms) and current capital around JPY 65.15 billion. It supplies risk capital to decarbonization businesses and is a major LP in Japan's climate VC funds (ONE Innovators, EEI Booster, UMI).
summary.local: 2022年10月28日設立の官民ファンド。改正地球温暖化対策推進法に基づき、設立時資本金204億円（国の産業投資102億円・民間82社102億円）、現在の資本金は約651.5億円。脱炭素事業へリスクマネーを供給し、国内クライメートVCの主要LPでもある。

summary.en: A JPY 6.06 billion fund-of-funds established November 2022, with the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as LP and MCP Asset Management as GP. It invests in decarbonization-focused VC funds; as of June 2026 it has committed to six underlying funds (ANRI-GREEN, UMI3 Decarbonization, EEI Booster1, ONE Carbon Neutral, IT-Farm Decarbonization, RealTech Fund 4) totaling ~JPY 5.8 billion.
